guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 打开此前持有 Drift 账户的钱包
guide.description: 使用 2026 年 4 月 1 日控制 Drift 账户的钱包。领取资格与该地址绑定，其他钱包不会显示可领取资产。请在该钱包中保留少量 SOL 支付网络手续费。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Open the Wallet That Held Your Drift Account
guide.original_description: Use the wallet that controlled your Drift account on April 1, 2026. Your claim is tied to that address, so any other wallet shows nothing to claim. Keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees.

guide.title: 打开 DFX 领取 portal
guide.description: 打开 DFX 领取 portal 并连接钱包。在签署任何内容前检查地址栏：官方 portal 使用 dfx.drift.trade。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the DFX claim portal and connect your wallet. Check the address bar before signing anything: the official portal runs on dfx.drift.trade.

guide.title: 查看 DFX 获配数量
guide.description: portal 通过 Merkle 证明，将钱包地址与损失快照匹配，显示准确的获配数量。原文称出现未分配恢复代币（No recovery tokens allocated）提示，意味着连接的钱包不正确。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The portal matches your address against the loss snapshot using a Merkle proof and shows your exact allocation. A “No recovery tokens allocated” message means you connected the wrong wallet.

guide.title: 接受 DFX 条款
guide.description: 勾选复选框，同意 DFX 条款。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Tick the boxes to agree to the DFX terms.

guide.title: 领取并确认交易
guide.description: 点击准备领取（Ready to Claim），在钱包中确认交易。如果有多笔分配，需要逐笔确认。原文称领取失败（Claim Failed）通常意味着钱包中的 SOL 不足以支付手续费，可补充少量 SOL 后重试。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click “Ready to Claim” and approve the transaction in your wallet. If you have more than one allocation, approve each one. A “Claim Failed” error usually means the wallet ran out of SOL for fees, so add a little and try again.

guide.title: 确认代币已到账
guide.description: 等待出现 DFX 已领取（DFX claimed）提示。屏幕会切换为已领取（Already Claimed），并显示查看交易（View Transaction）链接，此时 DFX 已进入钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Wait for the “DFX claimed” message. The screen switches to “Already Claimed” with a View Transaction link, and the DFX is now in your wallet.

存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

sourcedDescription: The original DRIFT airdrop has ended. The live distribution is the DFX recovery token, claimable by wallets that lost funds in the April 1 exploit. Allocations are already fixed in the loss snapshot, so there is nothing left to farm.
tagline_en: The original DRIFT airdrop has ended. The live distribution is the DFX recovery token, claimable by wallets that lost funds in the April 1 exploit. Allocations are already fixed in the loss snapshot, so there is nothing left to farm.

sourcedSteps.title: Open the Wallet That Held Your Drift Account
sourcedSteps.body: Use the wallet that controlled your Drift account on April 1, 2026. Your claim is tied to that address, so any other wallet shows nothing to claim. Keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees.

sourcedSteps.title: Visit the DFX Claim Portal
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the DFX claim portal and connect your wallet. Check the address bar before signing anything: the official portal runs on dfx.drift.trade.

sourcedSteps.title: Check Your DFX Allocation
sourcedSteps.body: The portal matches your address against the loss snapshot using a Merkle proof and shows your exact allocation. A “No recovery tokens allocated” message means you connected the wrong wallet.

sourcedSteps.title: Accept the DFX Terms
sourcedSteps.body: Tick the boxes to agree to the DFX terms.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim and Approve the Transaction
sourcedSteps.body: Click “Ready to Claim” and approve the transaction in your wallet. If you have more than one allocation, approve each one. A “Claim Failed” error usually means the wallet ran out of SOL for fees, so add a little and try again.

sourcedSteps.title: Confirm the Tokens Arrived
sourcedSteps.body: Wait for the “DFX claimed” message. The screen switches to “Already Claimed” with a View Transaction link, and the DFX is now in your wallet.
